    How Does PPC (Pay-Per-Click) Work?

    Our PPC services in Chennai work on an Ad Auction based system in search engines. Obviously, you will want your ads to reach a profitable audience by ranking high in search engine results. After deciding a budget for the PPC campaign, the sponsored ads are displayed over the Search Engine Results Pages (SERPs). These appear before or after the organic results based on the keywords a person has used in their search.

    Cost Per Click (CPC) is a small pre-decided amount that the advertiser needs to pay if the customer clicks on the ad.

    FAQ

    How do you define PPC Marketing?

    Pay Per Click (PPC) marketing is a popular advertising model of internet marketing. In this model, the advertisers pay the ad publishers a pre-determined amount every time their ads are clicked by customers. This increases your website visibility and visits through paid promotions, rather than through organic searches and visits.

    What is Google AdWords? How does it work?

    Google AdWords is a PPC Advertising platform that offers advertisers ways to reach potential customers via Google Search networks and Google Display networks. This is different from social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram in terms of the way the ad reaches the audience.

    What does Quality Score mean?

    Quality score is a variable used by Google which influences the rank of the website as well as the advertisement’s Cost Per Click (CPC). Each ad has a particular bid and a quality score (Quality Index as per Yahoo!). According to their quality score, ads are listed in descending order during search results.

    Are there targeting options I can choose from for my PPC Ads?

    Targeting options are endless for PPC Ads. Search Ads, Display Ads, and Contextual Targeting are some common techniques used to display PPC Ads online. Remarketing, Retargeting, and Product Listing Ads are also popular methods marketers use to promote websites and products the customers have already viewed on the Internet.

    For social media and connecting brands to customers online, there are Google Shopping Ads and Gmail Sponsored Ads. Social media can be used to display Instagram Ads and video ads. Depending upon your target audience, location-based marketing, type of product, and budget among many other factors, you can choose the ideal targeting option for your ads.

    Is there a fixed price for PPC ad campaigns?

    pricing for PPC ad campaigns are dynamic – they are not fixed and are constantly changing. This depends on the quality score and bid of the ads and websites. Since you only have to pay every time a customer clicks on your ad, it is hard to give a clear amount for each month. Based on several such factors including the budget you have fixed for your ads; an affordable estimate can be drawn at the start of the contract.
